items.title: 14.4.6 Applications of Vectors in Real World (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Mubarak ho, aap kitab ke aakhri numbered sabaq tak pahunch gaye! Ab tak humne vectors ke products ko zyada tar geometry (area, volume, plane) mein dekha. Lekin vectors sirf kaghaz ki lakeerein nahin; engineer, plumber, dukandar sab inhein (shayad naam liye baghair) roz istemal karte hain. Is page par kitab teen asal zindagi ki misaalen deti hai, aur har misaal mein ek alag auzaar kaam karta hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Naqsha yeh hai: Example 29 mein cross product se torque (ghumane ka asar), Example 30 mein vector ke magnitude se force ka size, aur Example 31 mein dot product se dukaan ki kul aamdani. Har misaal se pehle khud se poochiye: "yahan kaun sa auzaar lagega aur kyun?" Yahi soch exam ke naye sawalon mein kaam aati hai.

blocks.title: Example 29
blocks.problem: A plumber exerts a force of 30 pounds along the negative \(y\)-axis on a lever connected to a machine. The pivot point of the lever is at the origin \((0, 0, 0)\), and the force is applied at the point \((1.2\text{ ft}, 0.5\text{ ft}, 0\text{ ft})\). Determine the torque produced by this force about the pivot point.
steps:
Given: force 30 pounds, negative \(y\)-axis ki taraf; pivot (ghoomne ka markaz) origin \(O(0, 0, 0)\) par; force point \((1.2, 0.5, 0)\) (feet mein) par lagi.
To find: pivot ke gird torque \(\underline{\tau}\).
Method: Key Concept ke mutabiq torque \(\underline{\tau} = \underline{r}\times \underline{F}\) hai, jahan \(\underline{r}\) pivot se us point tak jata hai jahan force lagi. Pehle \(\underline{r}\) aur \(\underline{F}\) ko components mein likhenge, phir cross product determinant se nikalenge.

Step 1: Position vector
\[\underline{r} = 1.2\underline{i} + 0.5\underline{j} + 0\underline{k}\]
Kyun: pivot origin par hai, is liye \(\underline{r}\) seedha point \((1.2, 0.5, 0)\) ka position vector hai. Agar pivot kahin aur hota to "point minus pivot" karna parta.

Step 2: Force vector
\[\underline{F} = 0\underline{i} - 30\underline{j} + 0\underline{k}\]
Kyun: force ka size 30 hai aur woh negative \(y\)-axis ki taraf (neeche) hai. Is liye sirf \(\underline{j}\) wala hissa hai, aur woh negative hai. \(\underline{i}\) aur \(\underline{k}\) ki taraf koi zor nahin, is liye 0.

Step 3: Cross product ka determinant
\[\underline{\tau} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ 1.2 & 0.5 & 0 \\ 0 & -30 & 0 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: cross product ka determinant formula: pehli row mein unit vectors, doosri mein \(\underline{r}\), teesri mein \(\underline{F}\). Dhyan dein: tarteeb \(\underline{r}\times \underline{F}\) hai; ulta karne se sign badal jayega.

Step 4: Expand karein
\[= \underline{i}\big[(0.5)(0) - (0)(-30)\big]\]
\[- \underline{j}\big[(1.2)(0) - (0)(0)\big]\]
\[+ \underline{k}\big[(1.2)(-30) - (0.5)(0)\big]\]
\[= 0\underline{i} - 0\underline{j} - 36\underline{k}\]
Kyun: har unit vector ke saath woh \(2\times 2\) aata hai jo us ka column kaatne se bachta hai; \(\underline{j}\) wale term par minus. Pehle do brackets zero aaye kyun ke un mein har product mein koi na koi zero hai.

Step 5: Torque likhein
\[\underline{\tau} = -36\underline{k}\ \text{pound-feet}\]
Kyun: torque ka size 36 hai aur us ka rukh negative \(z\)-axis ki taraf hai. Torque ka rukh ghoomne wali axis batata hai: lever \(xy\)-plane mein ghoomta hai, is liye torque \(z\)-axis ki seedh mein hai.

Tasdeeq: force \(y\)-axis ki seedh mein hai, to \(\underline{r}\) ka sirf woh hissa ghumata hai jo is ke aar paar hai, yani \(x\) ki taraf \(1.2\) ft. \(30\times 1.2 = 36\). Rukh: \(\underline{i}\times(-\underline{j}) = -\underline{k}\), yani negative \(z\). Dono baatein mil gayin.
blocks.answer: \(\underline{\tau} = -36\underline{k}\) pound-feet; yani torque 36 pound-feet hai, negative \(z\)-direction mein.

blocks.title: Key Concept
blocks.text:
Torque measures the turning (rotational) effect of a force applied to an object about a pivot point. It is found by taking the cross product of the position vector \(\underline{r}\) (which runs from the pivot point to the point where the force is applied) and the force vector \(\underline{F}\) itself.
Mathematically, \(\underline{\tau} = \underline{r}\times \underline{F}\).

blocks.alt: A wrench turning a hexagonal bolt. The position vector r runs along the handle from the bolt (the pivot) to the end of the handle, where the force F is applied at an angle theta to the extension of r. The torque vector tau points along the axis of the bolt.
blocks.caption: Figure: torque on a wrench, τ = r × F (original drawing after the textbook's Key Concept figure)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Torque woh cheez hai jo cheezon ko ghumati hai: spanner se nut kholna, darwaza qabzon (hinges) par ghumana, plumber ka lever. Zyada force lagao, ya wahi force pivot se zyada door lagao, to ghumana aasan ho jata hai. Isi liye lamba spanner phansa hua nut aasani se khol deta hai, aur darwaze ka handle qabzon se door lagaya jata hai. Formula mein bhi yahi hai: \(|\underline{\tau}| = |\underline{r}||\underline{F}|\sin\theta\). Agar force bilkul handle ki seedh mein lagao (\(\theta = 0\), \(\sin 0 = 0\)) to kuch nahin ghoomta; aazma kar dekhiye, darwaze ko qabze ki taraf dhakelne se woh nahin khulta.
Units: force pounds mein aur faasla feet mein, to torque pound-feet mein. Kitab ek line mein "pound-feet" aur agli mein "feet-pounds" likhti hai; dono ek hi unit ke naam hain (lb·ft), is liye ghabraiye nahin.

Ab doosri misaal, jo pehli se kahin aasan hai magar ek zaroori sabaq deti hai. Construction site par crane ek concrete block ko kheench rahi hai. Force teen taraf zor laga rahi hai: \(x\), \(y\) aur \(z\) ki taraf. Sawal yeh hai ke kul mila kar force kitni bari hai. Yahan na cross product chahiye na dot product; sirf vector ki lambai (magnitude) ka formula, jo aap 14.1 mein parh chuke hain. Sabaq yeh hai: har sawal mein sab se bara auzaar uthana zaroori nahin; pehle dekhiye ke sawal poochh kya raha hai.

blocks.title: Example 30
blocks.problem: During a building construction, a crane exerts a force to pull a concrete block, represented by the vector \(\underline{F} = [4500, 3300, 2140]\) Newton. Each component corresponds to the force exerted along the \(x\), \(y\), and \(z\) axes, respectively. What is the magnitude of this force?
steps:
Given: \(\underline{F} = [4500, 3300, 2140]\) N, yani \(\underline{F} = 4500\underline{i} + 3300\underline{j} + 2140\underline{k}\).
To find: force ka magnitude (size) \(|\underline{F}|\).
Method: space mein vector ki lambai ka formula \(\sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2}}\) hai (14.1). Bas components rakhne hain.

Step 1: Formula likhein
\[|\underline{F}| = \sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{4500^{2} + 3300^{2} + 2140^{2}}\]
Kyun: teeno components aapas mein perpendicular hain, is liye lambai teen dimension wale Pythagoras se nikalti hai.

Step 2: Har component ka square
\[4500^{2} = 20250000\]
\[3300^{2} = 10890000\]
\[2140^{2} = 4579600\]
Kyun: bari values hain, is liye har square alag alag nikaliye; zeros ginne mein ghalti na ho. Misaal: \(4500^{2} = 45^{2}\times 100^{2} = 2025\times 10000\).

Step 3: Jama kar ke square root
\[20250000 + 10890000 + 4579600\]
\[= 35719600\]
\[|\underline{F}| = \sqrt{35719600}\]
\[\approx 5976.59\]
Kyun: jama ka square root hi magnitude hai. Yeh perfect square nahin, is liye do decimal tak round kiya (calculator se).

Tasdeeq: \(5976.59^{2} \approx 35719628\), jo \(35719600\) ke bohat qareeb hai (farq sirf rounding ka). Aur magnitude sab se bare component \(4500\) se zyada aur teeno ke jama \(9940\) se kam hona chahiye; \(5976.59\) theek is beech mein hai.
blocks.answer: Crane ki force ka magnitude taqreeban \(5976.59\) Newton hai.

blocks.text: Teesri misaal shayad sab se dilchasp hai, kyun ke is mein koi physics nahin, seedhi dukaan ki baat hai. Maan lijiye aap ki apni dukaan hai. Ek vector mein aap likhte hain ke har cheez kitni biki, aur doosre vector mein har cheez ki qeemat. Dot product in dono ko jori jori zarb kar ke jama karta hai, aur yahi to kul aamdani nikalne ka tareeqa hai jo har dukandar zubani karta hai! Yani dot product koi ajeeb cheez nahin, aap use roz istemal karte hain, bas naam nahin lete. Computer spreadsheets mein bhi bilkul yahi hisaab hota hai.

blocks.title: Example 31
blocks.problem: The components of \(\underline{u} = 300\underline{i} + 250\underline{j} + 180\underline{k}\) represent the respective number of jackets, shoes, and handbags sold at a store. The components of \(\underline{v} = 3500\underline{i} + 4200\underline{j} + 6840\underline{k}\) represent the respective prices (in rupees) per unit for each product. Find \(\underline{u}\cdot \underline{v}\) and explain what the result tells us in real life.
steps:
Given: \(\underline{u} = 300\underline{i} + 250\underline{j} + 180\underline{k}\) (bikne wali jackets, shoes, handbags ki tadaad) aur \(\underline{v} = 3500\underline{i} + 4200\underline{j} + 6840\underline{k}\) (har cheez ki qeemat rupees mein).
To find: \(\underline{u}\cdot \underline{v}\) aur us ka matlab.
Method: components mein dot product: milte julte components zarb karo, phir jama karo (14.2). Yahan "milte julte" ka matlab hai: jackets ki tadaad jackets ki qeemat ke saath, waghera.

Step 1: Dot product likhein
\[\underline{u}\cdot \underline{v} = (300\underline{i} + 250\underline{j} + 180\underline{k})\]
\[\cdot\,(3500\underline{i} + 4200\underline{j} + 6840\underline{k})\]
Kyun: dot product \(\underline{i}\) ko \(\underline{i}\) se, \(\underline{j}\) ko \(\underline{j}\) se aur \(\underline{k}\) ko \(\underline{k}\) se jorta hai.

Step 2: Milte julte components zarb karein
\[(300)(3500) = 1{,}050{,}000\]
\[(250)(4200) = 1{,}050{,}000\]
\[(180)(6840) = 1{,}231{,}200\]
Kyun: har product (tadaad) \(\times\) (qeemat) hai, yani ek qisam ki cheez se kamaye gaye paise. Misaal: 300 jackets, har ek 3500 ki, to jackets se 10 lakh 50 hazar.

Step 3: Jama karein
\[\underline{u}\cdot \underline{v} = 1{,}050{,}000 + 1{,}050{,}000 + 1{,}231{,}200\]
\[= 3{,}331{,}200\]
Kyun: dot product teeno products ka jama hai.

Step 4: Asal zindagi mein matlab
Jackets se Rs. 1,050,000, shoes se Rs. 1,050,000 aur handbags se Rs. 1,231,200 aaye. Dot product inhein jama karta hai, is liye yeh store ki kul aamdani (total revenue) hai, yani bikri se aane wali kul raqam.
Kyun: tadaad \(\times\) qeemat = aamdani, aur dot product ka kaam hi "jori jori zarb karo aur jama karo" hai.

Tasdeeq: mota andaza: \(300\times 3500 \approx 10\) lakh, \(250\times 4200 \approx 10\) lakh, \(180\times 6840 \approx 12\) lakh; kul taqreeban 33 lakh. Hisaab \(3{,}331{,}200\) (taqreeban 33.3 lakh) is se mil raha hai.
blocks.answer: \(\underline{u}\cdot \underline{v} = 3{,}331{,}200\). Is ka matlab hai ke teeno products bechne se store ki kul aamdani (total revenue) Rs. 3,331,200 hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke jawab mein "selling all the three product" chhapa hai. Sahi "three products" (jama ka seegha) hai: teeno products ki bikri.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Ek chhota torque ka sawal (yeh hamara sawal hai): spanner ka siraa pivot se \(\underline{r} = 2\underline{i}\) (meter) par hai aur force \(\underline{F} = 5\underline{j}\) newton hai. Torque?
\[\underline{\tau} = \underline{r}\times \underline{F} = 2\underline{i}\times 5\underline{j} = 10(\underline{i}\times \underline{j}) = 10\underline{k}\]
Yani 10 newton-meter, positive \(z\)-direction mein. Force handle par seedhi 90 degree par hai, is liye poori force ghumane mein lagi: \(2\times 5 = 10\).

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Example 29 mein agar plumber wahi 30 pounds ki force negative \(x\)-axis ki taraf lagata (\(\underline{F} = -30\underline{i}\)), to torque kya hota?
Jawab: \(\underline{r}\times \underline{F} = (1.2\underline{i} + 0.5\underline{j})\times(-30\underline{i}) = 0.5(-30)(\underline{j}\times \underline{i}) = -15(-\underline{k}) = 15\underline{k}\). Ab sirf \(0.5\) ft wala hissa kaam aaya, is liye torque kam (15) hai aur rukh bhi ulta.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Torque: \(\underline{\tau} = \underline{r}\times \underline{F}\); \(\underline{r}\) pivot se force wale point tak.
2. \(\underline{F} = [x, y, z]\) ka magnitude: \(|\underline{F}| = \sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2}}\).
3. Tadaad \(\cdot\) qeemat (dot product) = kul aamdani.
4. Vector jawab ke saath unit aur rukh (direction) zaroor likhiye.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(\underline{r}\times \underline{F}\) ki jagah \(\underline{F}\times \underline{r}\) nikal lena: torque ka sign ulta ho jata hai.
2. Negative \(y\)-axis wali force ko \(+30\underline{j}\) likh dena. "Neeche" ya "negative" ka matlab minus sign.
3. Example 31 ka jawab vector bana dena. Dot product ka jawab number hai: rupees ki ek raqam.
4. Bari values ke squares mein zeros ginne ki ghalti; har square alag likhiye.
